owner: Government of Tanzania / TTCL (state telecom operator)
notes: Official NIDC pages (A, methodology-anchored) state the Government of Tanzania constructed the National Internet Data Center in 2015, described as a modern Tier-III data centre in Dar es Salaam operated with/by TTCL, offering cloud/colocation services. btw.media company story (B): NIDC provides secure Tier-III colocation, virtual server hosting, web/email and domain services in Dar es Salaam. Government procurement documents (planning.go.tz) show government paying for NIDC space. Capacity (MW/racks) not published.
